race.description: Grand Final Day @ Murray Bridge Racecourse Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: FINAL COUNTDOWN (7) has been building up her fitness levels in 3 tougher fields than this since resuming from a spell, and an extra 100m will do her no harm. She benefits from a 3kg claim and can get the job done here. ROYAL FOX (8) has been back to the trials since not having all favours here 4 weeks ago. Dropping back from 1600m to 1400m is the key, and he is worth another chance. SHE'S TERNACIOUS (4) is a stablemate of the third pick who also won her last start, when sailing home to score by nearly a length from well back on the turn. She cops a wide draw, but should again be hitting the line hard. STAR CASINO (1) will lump a big weight even after a 4kg claim, but he does have the pole position, and is worth including in all top 4 combos to be safe. TANNENBURG (3) is backing up quickly, and also has a wide gate, but he is not out of this. Each way value.
